assertions.assertion: Uses context.Caller to differentiate between token types
assertions.rationale: Branches on context.Caller to decide the claim set per token type.

assertions.assertion: Emits a minimal claim set (e.g. just name) for identity tokens
assertions.rationale: Identity-token branch adds only JwtClaimTypes.Name and returns.

assertions.assertion: Emits a richer claim set for access tokens, using AddRequestedClaims for scope filtering
assertions.rationale: Access-token branch builds name/email/department/cost_center/role and passes them through context.AddRequestedClaims.
